Need produce final with code. Need think about robust parsing. ISO-8601 duration: P[n]Y[n]M[n]D[T[n]H[n]M[n]S] maybe fractional seconds? Need handle invalid input. Could use regex. Need convert to timedelta. Python timedelta supports days, seconds, microseconds. Years/months not directly. Need decide how to handle Y/M. ISO-8601 duration includes years and months. To convert to timedelta, need approximate? Could raise ValueError for years/months? But user says like P3DT4H5M. Could support P... with D,H,M,S and maybe fractional seconds. If Y/M present, maybe convert using average? Better to be explicit: support days/hours/minutes
